O. N. H. OWENS — HIS DAY JOB AND HIS FIRST NAME
===============================================
Recovered 2026-09-06 under p_430 (sweep the corpus on the camp's PEOPLE, not on "Camp Kanawana").
Open Library search-inside, `openlibrary.org/search/inside.json`. None of these books was read;
every line below is a search highlight, and the two longer ones were reconstructed by walking
overlapping phrase queries.

WHY OWENS. traditions/order-of-owens.md identifies O. N. H. Owens with "Norrey Owens", the donor of
the Order of Owens, on the strength of both names holding the presidency of the Quebec Camping
Association. It records forty-eight years of Montreal YMCA camping service, 1929 to 1977 — and NO
OCCUPATION. It also flags, as "suggestive but unproven", a Library and Archives Canada First World
War personnel file for "OWENS, OWEN NORREYS HARRINGTON".

THE QUERY THAT WORKED was the index form of the name, "Owens, O. N. H." — not the running form.
Two hits, both the same book.

1. FINANCIAL POST, *DIRECTORY OF DIRECTORS*, 1947  [directoryofdirec0000unse_h0p6,
   directoryofdirec0000unse_n6h5, directoryofdirec0000unse_n8a1 — three scans of one edition]

   His own index entry:
     "OWENS, O. N. H.; man. dir. Central Investment Corp., 1240 Phillips Sq., Montreal"
   (the n6h5 scan prints the address as "1240 Union Ave., Montreal" — the same block; Phillips
   Square is where Birks' flagship store stands)

   And the company entry, reconstructed over five queries:
     "... 2, P.Q.  Directors — H. G. Birks, pres.; V. M. Birks, vice-pres.; O. N. H. OWENS, MAN.
      DIR.; R. R. Johnson, G. D. Birks.  Other Exec. Officers ..."

   So: managing director of a Birks family investment company, sitting on its board with three
   Birkses. Gerald W. Birks was president of the YMCA of Montreal in 1922 (people/directors-index.md).

2. ART INDEX, vol. 1  [artindex0001unse]

     "OWENS, Owen N. H.  Incorporating a parking garage in the office building.  Arch Forum
      52:897-902"

   THE ONLY SOURCE FOUND THAT SPELLS THE LEADING GIVEN NAME. *Architectural Forum* vol. 52 is 1930.

3. THE ARTICLE IS STILL CITED  [isbn_9780773759749 / bwb_KS-292-791]

   *Montreal Metropolis, 1880-1930* / *Montréal métropole, 1880-1930* (Canadian Centre for
   Architecture, 1998), in both its editions:
     "... can be found in N.H. Owens, 'Incorporating a Parking Garage in the Office Building,'
      Architectural [Forum] ..."
     "... est illustrée dans N.H. Owens, « Incorporating a Parking Garage in the Office Building »,
      Architectural [Forum] ..."
   Which Montreal building the CCA is discussing was not recovered — the surrounding sentence did
   not come back on two attempts.

WHAT IS JOINED AND WHAT IS NOT
------------------------------
The Directory's "O. N. H. Owens" and the Art Index's "Owen N. H. Owens" are joined by initials,
surname, city and subject: a Montreal investment-company managing director writing on how to put a
parking garage inside an office building is a man writing about his own trade. THAT IS A STRONG
READING AND NOT A DOCUMENT. No source found names both the Central Investment Corp. post and the
Architectural Forum article.

The LAC file's "OWEN NORREYS HARRINGTON" is likewise now supported rather than proved: "Owen N. H."
supplies the leading given name the wiki said no document in the corpus spells out, and it explains
the 1929 YMCA listing as "N. H. Owens" — a man called Owen Owens dropping the first of them.

NULLS FROM THE SAME PASS, so nobody repeats them: "Kanawanna" 0, "Lac Kanawana" 0, "Kanawana, Que"
0, "Lake Kanawana" 1 (Stuart McLean's *Vinyl Cafe Notebooks*, already held). The camp's name forms
are exhausted. "McGerrigle" returns 346, "Duncan Patton" 107 and "Hedley S. Dimock" 269 — too many
to enumerate unpaired, and none of them swept yet.
